decisions.reason: The metro data centre network rests on sunk owned-fibre investment, had publicly reported adoption, and is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, so the firm stays committed despite the lack of recent website mentions.

Optical spectrum connectivity uses existing fibre assets, was showcased on its own page, and fits the high-bandwidth strategy, so the costs already incurred and the public commitment favour persisting with it.

The number ordering portal is a low-cost software platform aligned with the real-time provisioning direction, and the absence of recent results can be put down to it being a support tool rather than a headline product.

Direct voice connection builds on the established voice infrastructure serving enterprise customers, and although legacy voice is declining, the firm attributes weak visibility to market shifts rather than failure and keeps it.
